days.title: High Plateau and Central Peaks
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Hallingskarvethochplateau
stops.detail: The national park largely comprises the Hallingskarvet high plateau, which was formed due to the Caledonian orogeny.

stops.name: Folarskardnuten
stops.detail: The highest mountain is the Folarskardnuten at 1,933 m.

stops.name: Flakavatnet
stops.detail: In Hallingskarvet is also Norway's highest lake, the Flakavatnet, which lies at an altitude of 1,453 m.

stops.name: Finsehytta
stops.detail: The Norwegian Trekking Association maintains the Finsehytta huts in the south and Geiterygghytta in the north of the park.

stops.name: Skarverennet
stops.detail: Between Finse and Ustaoset, a section of the Skarverennet runs through the park.

stops.name: Rallarvegen
stops.detail: The Rallarvegen also runs through the south of the park.
